dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product separates groups of content with a quiet line, horizontally and vertically, across the full length or inset to align with the content it separates.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a divider reads: the line's color and thickness, the length it is shortened by at its start (or at both ends) when inset, the gap between the dots of a dotted line, the length and gap of a dashed line's dashes, and the amplitude and wavelength of a wavy line.
rules: A divider adds no space around itself; put the gap in the layout that places it.
Keep dividers decorative unless the grouping itself is meaningful (a toolbar's or a menu's groups).
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw a line of your own.

A dotted, dashed or wavy divider is a distinction inside one product (a tear line, a boundary of something provisional, a light section break). Choose it per instance with the lineStyle prop; the default divider stays solid.
The dot, dash and wave lengths are derived from line.thickness, so a layer that thickens the line keeps the pattern's proportions. Set them in a layer only to change the proportions themselves.

thickness.$description: The line's extent across its axis: the side of a dot, the width of a dash, the width of the wave's stroke.

inset.$description: How far the line is shortened at its start (inset start) or at both ends (inset both): the inline-start of a horizontal divider, the top of a vertical one. A divider's insetLength replaces it for that divider.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product draws a dotted divider (leaders in a summary, a quiet boundary between entries) beside its solid ones, and spaces the dots for its own density.

gap.$description: The least space between two dots of a dotted line, from one dot's edge to the next. A dot is as long as the line is thick. The divider widens the gaps equally so that a whole dot ends the line at each end.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product draws a dashed divider (a tear line, the edge of a draft or an optional section) beside its solid and dotted ones; a dash must read as a dash, not as a long dot, at the product's own line thickness.

length.$description: The length of one dash of a dashed line, round caps included. A dash is never drawn shorter than the line is thick.

gap.$description: The least space between two dashes, from one dash's edge to the next. The divider widens the gaps equally so that a whole dash ends the line at each end.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product breaks a long page or a playful surface with a wavy line beside the straight dividers of its lists, and needs the wave's height and length to suit that surface.

amplitude.$description: How far the wave's crest lies from the line's midline, measured to the center of the stroke. The divider takes twice this plus line.thickness across its axis. 0 draws a straight line.

wavelength.$description: The length of one whole wave, a crest and a trough. The divider stretches or shrinks it so that a whole number of waves fills the line.
